reading_page.title: Read this short scenario
reading_page.text: A cell is placed in a solution with a lower water potential than its cytoplasm. Water moves across the selectively permeable membrane.

questions.question: In which direction will water move?
questions.explanation: Water moves by osmosis from higher water potential to lower water potential, so it leaves the cell in this scenario.
questions.similar_question: What happens to an animal cell in a strongly hypertonic solution?

questions.question: Name the organelle that contains chromosomes.
questions.explanation: In a eukaryotic cell, chromosomes are housed inside the nucleus.
questions.similar_question: Name the organelle where ribosomal subunits begin assembly.
